about.title: About Hoa Phu Mechanical Co., Ltd.
about.lead: A supplier of machinery, production lines and mechanical services for the wood industry, supporting workshops and factories from consulting to installation.
about.storyTitle: Our story and commercial presence in the industry
about.storyText: Hoa Phu Mechanical Co., Ltd. is based in Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, focusing on new and used woodworking machines, production lines, industrial conveyors and mechanical fabrication services. We serve furniture workshops and wood processing plants in Ho Chi Minh City and the southern provinces.

services.title: Fabrication, installation and machining services
services.lead: Hoa Phu supports wood workshops from site survey and solution consulting to fabrication, supply and installation of production lines, conveyors and custom mechanical parts.

cards.title: Automated line consulting & installation
cards.text: We configure and install finger-jointing lines, UV coating and curing lines for flooring and automatic panel coating lines that match each factory’s floor space, output and products.

cards.title: Custom industrial conveyor design
cards.text: We design roller, PVC, rubber, chain, stainless mesh and heat-resistant Kevlar conveyors sized to your stock, load and temperature at every stage of the production line.

cards.title: Precision mechanical fabrication
cards.text: We machine parts and woodworking accessories such as aluminium chair frames, gearboxes and hydraulic power units from drawings or samples, for repairs and new builds.

steps.title: Receive your request
steps.text: We listen to your needs, products and floor layout by phone, Zalo or form.

steps.title: Survey & consulting
steps.text: We survey the site and propose the machine or line setup for your target output.

steps.title: Quote & build/supply
steps.text: We send a detailed quote, agree the schedule, then fabricate or supply the equipment.

steps.title: Install & hand over
steps.text: We install, test run, train your team on safe operation and hand over the equipment.
